name: Lifemare
source: In this short visual novel, a teenager appears to have it all — loyal friends and a girl who may just return his feelings. But when a devastating diagnosis strikes, his bright youth is suddenly eclipsed by darkness and despair.
translation: 在这部短篇视觉小说中，一个青少年似乎拥有一切——忠诚的朋友和一个可能只是回报他感情的女孩。但当毁灭性的诊断袭来时，他明亮的青春突然被黑暗和绝望所掩盖。
